name: chatty-plugin
purpose: Valid project whose .solhint.json loads a plugin (planted by the case runner, never committed) that prints non-Solhint lines to stdout and stderr and exports no rules. The run is not degraded: the chatter must not be reported as a problem, and nothing may reach the MCP stdout channel (C3).
